description: Source code for listing and traversing objects in a Git repository, including functions for processing blobs, trees, commits, and tags, with filtering and depth control.

classes.name: traversal_context
classes.description: Holds context information for traversing Git objects, including revision info, callbacks, filters, and depth.

methods.name: show_commit
methods.description: Calls the show_commit callback if set, to display a commit.

methods.name: show_object
methods.description: Calls the show_object callback if set, to display an object, considering pack status.

methods.name: process_blob
methods.description: Processes a blob object, applying filters and possibly displaying it.

methods.name: process_tree_contents
methods.description: Iterates over entries in a tree, processing subtrees and blobs.

methods.name: process_tree
methods.description: Processes a tree object, including filtering, displaying, and recursive traversal of contents.

methods.name: process_tag
methods.description: Processes a tag object, applying filters and displaying if needed.

methods.name: mark_edge_parents_uninteresting
methods.description: Marks parent commits of a given commit as uninteresting, optionally showing edges.

methods.name: add_edge_parents
methods.description: Adds parent commits of a given commit to a set, marking them as uninteresting and optionally showing edges.

methods.name: mark_edges_uninteresting
methods.description: Marks commits and their parent edges as uninteresting, with options for sparse marking and aggressive edge hinting.

methods.name: add_pending_tree
methods.description: Adds a tree object to the list of objects pending traversal.

methods.name: traverse_non_commits
methods.description: Processes non-commit objects pending traversal, including tags, trees, and blobs.

methods.name: do_traverse
methods.description: Main traversal loop over revisions, processing commits and non-commit objects.
